messages:
Eve: Quick weekend check 1 1 morning ridge hike (9am) or boardgame night at my place (7pm)? small reasons welcome :mountain::game_die:
Cal: Hike for me. need fresh air and will bring blueberries for the summit snack :blueberries:
Jin: Boardgames! i owe @Harper a revenge in Catan. also can bring tea and snacks.
Harper: Game night sounds fun. who can host parking? my car is tiny.
Eve: I have one driveway spot and a small curb spot. also thinking of a short 6-mile loop for the hike, pretty mellow.
Cal: logistics note: park lot near the trail fills by 8:45 on weekends. might carpool or meet at the 8:15 BART.
Jin: vote with just "hike" or "games"
Cal: hike
Jin: games
Harper: games
Eve: tally 2 games, 1 hike. still time to flip.
ops-bot: Reminder: Local trail advisory 1 hikers should carry water and avoid the east ridge after storms due to mud. Check trail status at parks.example.com.
Cal: thanks @ops-bot. if we hike i'll bring extra socks and a small first-aid kit.
Harper: if games win, i'll bring Catan, Wingspan, and a folding table. also i can host if @Eve wants an early hike.
Eve: plan: keep both open. final check Friday 6pm. if games: meet at Harper's 7pm, bring snacks/drinks and small cash for pizza. if hike: meet BART and carpool 8:15, trailhead 9am.
Jin: works for me. PS: anyone want mocktails for game night? i make a mean ginger-lime spritz.
Cal: save me a slice of pizza either way. hope the weather holds! :umbrella_on_ground:
Eve: i'll post final plan Friday 6pm and drop exact addresses. enjoy the week!
